title: Introduction To Assam
author: Dimbeswar Neog
description: Comprehensive historical survey published in 1947 by Dimbeswar Neog examining the ethnological roots of Assam's diverse population, highlighting the Tai migrations (Ahom, Khamyang, Phake, Khamti) and their foundational role in building Assamese society.
